article.title: Par aspectual говорить/сказать
article.chapter: Aspecto imperfectivo/perfectivo: fundamentos — Вид глагола: основы

claims.sectionKey: говорить y сказать se relacionan aspectualmente en muchos contextos de habla
claims.summary: Both verbs relate aspectually in many speaking contexts.

claims.sectionKey: говорить enfoca el desarrollo o la repetición del habla
claims.summary: Говорить focuses on the development or repetition of speech.

claims.sectionKey: сказать presenta en cambio una emisión concreta como una unidad
claims.summary: Сказать presents a concrete emission as a unit.

claims.sectionKey: La traducción española depende por ello del contexto y no de una equivalencia palabra por palabra
claims.summary: The Spanish translation depends on context, not a direct word-for-word equivalence.

links.notes: The Wikipedia article on Aspect (grammar) explains that говорить and сказать relate aspectually in various speaking contexts, supporting the claim.
The same Wikipedia article states that говорить emphasizes the process of speaking, such as in 'Она говорила очень тихо' (She spoke very softly).
According to the Wikipedia article, сказать is used for a specific, delimited act of speaking, as in 'Он сказал правду' (He said the truth).
The article explicitly states that говорить and сказать are not interchangeable in all contexts, and their Spanish translations depend on the context, not a direct word-for-word equivalence.
